spans.s:
बद् बद् or बन्द्, cl. 1. P. बदति, बन्-
दति, बबाद, बदितुम्, &c., to be steady,
to be firm; [cf. rt. 1. पद्.]

बदर बदर, अस्, m. (later also वदर),
the jujube tree, Zizyphus Jujuba or Z. Scandens;
a kind of mustard (= देव-सर्षप); the kernel
of the fruit of the cotton plant; N. of a man [cf.
बादरायण]; (आ), f., N. of various plants; the
cotton shrub; a particular species of bulbous plant
(= गृष्टि, वाराही); Mimosa Octandra (= एला-
पर्णी); Clitoria Ternatea (= विष्णु-क्रान्ता); (ई), f.
the jujube tree; the cotton shrub; Mucuna Pruritus
(= कपि-कच्छु); N. of one of the sources of the
Gaṅgā and of the hermitage of Nara and Nārāyaṇa
situated near it [cf. बदरिका]; (अम्), n. the edible
fruit of the jujube; the berry or pod of the cotton
shrub; the same berry used as a weight.
—बदर-
कुण, अस्, m. the time when the fruit of the jujube
becomes ripe.
—बदर-पाचन, अम्, n., N. of a
sacred bathing-place (‘where the jujube ripens’).
—ब-
दर-फली, f. a species of jujube tree (= भू-ब-
दरी).
—बदर-यूष, a decoction of the fruit of
the jujube.
—बदरामलक (˚र-आम्˚), अम्, n.
Flacourtia Cataphracta (probably the fruit rather than
the plant itself).
—बदरी-च्छद, अस्, आ, m. f. a
kind of perfume (apparently a dried shell-fish, =
शङ्ख-नखी); (आ), f. a species of jujube tree
(= हस्ति-कोलि).
—बदरी-तपोवन, अम्, n. the
penance grove or hermitage at Badarī.
—बदरी-
नाथ, अस्, m., N. of a temple at Badarī.
—बदरी-
नारायण, N. of a place.
—बदरी-पत्त्र, अस्, m.
a kind of perfume (= नखी).
—बदरीपत्त्रक,
अम्, n. a kind of perfume, a leaf.
—बदरी-पाचन
= बदर-पाचन, q. v.
—बदरी-प्रस्थ, अस्, m.,
N. of a city.
—बदरी-फल, अम्, n. the fruit of
the jujube tree; (आ), f., N. of a plant, a variety of
Śephālikā or Nyctanthes with blue flowers.
—ब-
दरी-मूल, अम्, n. the root of the jujube tree.
—बदरी-वण or बदरी-वन, अम्, n. a wood
of jujube trees; N. of a place.
—बदरी-वासा, f.
‘dwelling at Badarī,’ an epithet of Durgā.
—बदरी-
शैल, अस्, m. ‘rock of Badarī,’ N. of a rocky emi-
nence at the source of the Gaṅgā in the Himālaya
range (a celebrated place of pilgrimage, the Bhadri-
nāth of modern travellers; or a town and temple on
the west bank of the Alaka-nandā river, in the
province of Śrī-nagar).

बादर बादर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. बदर), be-
longing to or derived from the jujube tree; made of
cotton; (अस्, आ), m. f. the cotton shrub; (आस्), m.
pl., N. of a people; (अम्), n. the jujube (= ब-
दर); the berry of Abrus Precatorius; the plant
itself; = वीर, (probably) a species of plant; silk;
water; a conch shell which winds in a direction
from left to right.
बदरि, इस्, f. = बदरी, the jujube tree.

बादरि, इस्, m., Ved. (a patronymic fr. बदर),
N. of a philosophical teacher mentioned in the Bā-
darāyaṇa-sūtras.

बदरिका, f. (fr. बदरा), the fruit of the
jujube (?); N. of one of the sources of the Gaṅgā
and of the neighbouring hermitage of Nara and
Nārāyaṇa (= बदरी).
—बदरिकाश्रम (˚का-
आश्˚), N. of a hermitage.

बादरिक, अस्, ई, अम्, one who gathers the fruit
of the jujube tree.
बद्ध बद्ध. See under rt. बन्ध्, col. 2.

बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound, tied, fixed, fastened;
chained, enchained, fettered; fastened or tied round,
bound on, put on, girt on, dressed; caught, captured,
confined, imprisoned; shut, stopped, closed, pre-
cluded; arrested, held back, checked, restrained,
suppressed, withheld; joined, connected, combined,
united; formed, constructed, built, embanked; inlaid,
studded [cf. रीति-ब्˚, लोह-ब्˚]; composed (as verses);
effected, produced; directed towards; formed, set (as
fruit); struck (as a root); firmly rooted, firm; placed
side by side (as the hollowed hands); clenched (as
the fist); knit (as the brows); contracted (as friend-
ship or enmity); taken up (as an abode); mani-
fested, evinced, displayed; entertained, cherished,
fostered, possessed, got; entangled, involved, en-
meshed; congealed, clotted (as blood; opposed to
द्रव, q. v.); (at the beginning of adj. comps.
बद्ध has often a vague sense analogous to that of
जात, q. v.; see examples below); (अस् or अम्), m.
or n.?, (with Jainas) that which binds or fetters
the embodied spirit (viz. connection of the soul with
deeds; it consists in a succession of births and deaths
as the result of works).
—बद्ध-कक्ष, अस्, आ,
अम्, one who has the loins girt, girt about the
loins, having a tightened girdle.
—बद्ध-कक्ष्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, having the girdle bound or girt up,
prepared, ready.
—बद्ध-कट, अस्, आ, अम्, made
of plaited grass.
—बद्ध-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, one
whose desires are restrained.
—बद्ध-केसर, अस्,
[]
आ, अम्, having hair formed, forming hair.
—बद्ध-
कोप, अस्, आ, अम्, having anger suppressed, smother-
ing resentment, governing wrath.
—बद्ध-गुद,
अम्, n. a dangerous kind of obstruction of the
bowels.
—बद्धगुदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering from
the above obstruction.
—बद्ध-गोधाङ्गुलित्र-
वत् (˚धा-अङ्˚), आन्, अती, अत्, (in archery) having
fastened a leathern guard on the left arm and
fingers; [cf. गो-धा.]
—बद्धगोधाङ्गुलि-त्राण,
अस्, आ, अम्, having fastened on a leathern guard
for the left arm and fingers.
—बद्ध-घण्ट,
अस्, आ, अम्, having bells bound on.
—बद्ध-चित्त,
अस्, आ, अम्, having the thoughts fixed, rivetting the
mind.
—बद्ध-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, tongue-tied,
moving the tongue with difficulty.
—बद्ध-ज्ञ-
ता, f. the state of having acquired knowledge, great
knowledge.
—बद्ध-तल, अस्, आ, अम्, one who
has put on a leathern guard (for the left arm).
—बद्ध-तूण, अस्, आ, अम्, having a quiver fas-
tened on, girt with a quiver.
—बद्ध-दृष्टि, इस्,
इस्, इ, having the eyes fixed, fixing the gaze (upon
anything).
—बद्ध-द्विरद-सेतु, उस्, उस्, उस्, hav-
ing elephants bound together for bridges.
—बद्-
ध-द्वेष, अस्, आ, अम्, contracting hatred.
—बद्-
ध-धारा-प्रवाह, अस्, आ, अम्, checking the flow
of (tear) drops.
—बद्ध-निश्चय, अस्, आ, अम्,
having a firm conviction, forming a firm resolve,
firmly resolved.
—बद्ध-निस्तृंश, अस्, आ, अम्,
girt with a falchion.
—बद्ध-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the eyes fixed, fixing the eyes (upon any-
thing).
—बद्ध-नेपथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, attired in
a theatrical costume.
—बद्ध-पङ्क-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, having the mud dried or hardened.
—बद्-
ध-पुरीष, अस्, आ, अम्, having the bowels ob-
structed or constipated.
—बद्धपुरीष-त्व, अम्,
n. the state of being constipated, obstruction of the
bowels.
—बद्ध-प्रतिज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, one who
has contracted an engagement, one who has made a
vow or promise.
—बद्ध-प्रतिश्रुत्, त्, त्, त्, in
which echoes are formed, resonant with echoing
sounds.
—बद्ध-फल, अस्, m. the plant Pon-
gamia Glabra (= करञ्ज).
—बद्ध-भाव, अस्,
आ, अम्, having the mind or heart fixed.
—बद्ध-
भीमान्धकार (˚म-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, enveloped
in terrible darkness.
—बद्ध-भू, ऊस्, f. the
lowest floor (‘fixed on the ground’); ground pre-
pared for the site of a house.
—बद्ध-भूमिक,
अस्, आ, अम्, having an inlaid floor.
—बद्ध-मुख,
अस्, ई, अम्, having the mouth or orifice closed.
—बद्ध-मुष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, having a closed fist;
close-fisted, griping, penurious, covetous; [cf. दृढ-
मुष्टि.]
—बद्धमुष्टि-कर, अस्, m. the hand
with closed fist.
—बद्धमुष्टि-त्व, अम्, n. the state
of having the fist closed (for holding a bow).
—बद्-
ध-मूत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, stopping or obstructing the
urine.
—बद्ध-मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, striking root
firmly, deeply rooted.
—बद्धमूल-ता, f. the state
of being firmly rooted.
—बद्ध-मौन, अस्, आ, अम्,
one by whom silence is observed, keeping silence.
—बद्ध-रभस, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has formed
an ardent attachment, passionately attached (to any
one).
—बद्ध-रसाल, अस्, m. a species of mango
(the most highly prized kind).
—बद्ध-राग, अस्,
आ, अम्, filled with passion, impassioned.
—बद्ध-
राज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having attained to royalty.
—बद्-
ध-वत्सा, f., scil. गौस्, a cow whose calf is tied
up (in the stall).
—बद्ध-वन्दन-मालक, अस्,
इका, अम्, having fastened garlands in token of wel-
come.
—बद्ध-वर्चस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, constipating
the bowels.
—बद्ध-वसति, इस्, इस्, इ, fixing an
abode.
—बद्ध-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, suppressing the
voice, maintaining silence, taciturn.
—बद्धविट्क,
अस्, आ, अम् (fr. बद्ध + विष्), one whose bowels
are constipated, costive.
—बद्धविट्क-ता, f. con-
stipation of the bowels, costiveness.
—बद्ध-विण्-
मूत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, obstructing the evacuations by
stool and by the bladder.
—बद्ध-वीर, अस्, आ,
अम्, whose heroes or soldiers are bound.
—बद्ध-
वेपथु, उस्, उस्, उ, seized with tremor, trembling.
—बद्ध-वैर, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has con-
tracted great enmity or confirmed hostility, feeling
[]
bitter hatred.
—बद्ध-शस्, an incorrect form for
बद्व-शस्, q. v.
—बद्ध-शिख, अस्, आ, अम्, one
whose hair is tied up into a single lock upon the
crown of the head; one who is still in childhood,
young, a child, a pupil (not yet tonsured); (आ), f. a
sort of pungent root, (according to some) a kind of
garlic.
—बद्ध-श्रोत्र-मनश्-चक्षुस्, उस्, उस्,
उस्, having the ears, mind, and eyes fixed; fixing the
ears, mind, and eyes.
—बद्ध-सूत, अस्, m. a par-
ticular preparation of quicksilver.
—बद्ध-स्नेह,
अस्, आ, अम्, forming an attachment, conceiving affection
for (with loc.).
—बद्धाङ्गुलि-त्र or बद्धाङ्-
गुलि-त्राण (˚ध-अङ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a finger-
guard fastened on, equipped with gauntlets.
—बद्-
धाञ्जलि (˚ध-अञ्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, having the hands
hollowed and placed side by side, with hands or
palms joined in humble entreaty, putting the joined
hands to the forehead, saluting respectfully; with
closed hands.
—बद्धाञ्जलि-पुट, अस्, आ, अम्,
forming a cup with the hollowed hands.
—बद्-
धात्मन् (˚ध-आत्˚), आ, m. (with Jainas) a soul
which is bound or fettered by deeds and works
previous to its deliverance.
—बद्धानन्द (˚ध-
आन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, feeling pleasure, joyful.
—बद्धा-
नुराग (˚ध-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, manifesting love,
feeling affection.
—बद्धानुशय (˚ध-अन्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, one whose purpose is fixed, of fixed
intent; taking aim.
—बद्धाम्बरचर-मार्ग
(˚ध-अम्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, obstructing the path of birds
(said of a conflagration).
—बद्धायुध (˚ध-
आय्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, accoutred with arms.
—बद्धा-
शङ्क (˚ध-आश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose suspicions
are raised, apprehensive.
—बद्धोत्सव (˚ध-
उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, observing a festival, enjoying a
holiday.
—बद्धोद्यम (˚ध-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
uniting efforts, making united efforts, having the
energies intently fixed.

बद्धक, अस्, m., Ved. one who is bound, a
captive, prisoner.

बद्ध्वा, ind. having bound or tied; having put
on; having joined.

बद्व, अम्, n., Ved. a large number, multitude;
a particular high number, (according to Sāy.) 100
Koṭis, (according to others) 10,000 millions; the
number 13084.
—बद्व-शस्, ind. in large numbers,
in multitudes; (also incorrectly written बद्ध-शस्.)
बद्वन्, आ, m. a causeway, highway.

बादरायण, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. बदर),
N. of a sage (said to be the author of the Śārīraka-
sūtras belonging to the Uttara-mīmāṃsā or Vedānta
philosophy and identified with Vyāsa, the reputed
compiler of the Vedas, Mahā-bhārata, Purāṇas, &c.;
also written वादरायण); N. of an astronomer;
of the author of a Dharma-śāstra; (अस्, ई, अम्),
composed by Bādarāyaṇa.
—बादरायण-सूत्र,
अम्, n., N. of the Vedānta aphorisms ascribed to
Bādarāyaṇa.

बादरायणि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Śuka, son
of Bādarāyaṇa or Vyāsa; a N. of Vyāsa.
